## Round-robin load balancing

The balancer hands each new request to the next server in the list, then starts over at the top.

<picture>
  <source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="patterns/round-robin.dark.svg">
  <img alt="Round-robin load balancing. Requests go to server 1, 2, 3, then 1 again." src="patterns/round-robin.light.svg">
</picture>

```ts
import { defineDiagram } from 'diagrammar';
import type { RenderDiagramOptions } from 'diagrammar/server';

const diagram = defineDiagram({
  title: 'Round-robin load balancing',
  description: 'Requests go to server 1, 2, 3, then 1 again.',
  nodes: [
    { id: 'client', label: 'Clients', type: 'actor' },
    { id: 'lb', label: 'Load balancer', role: 'primary', icon: 'globe' },
    { id: 's1', label: 'Server 1', icon: 'server' },
    { id: 's2', label: 'Server 2', icon: 'server' },
    { id: 's3', label: 'Server 3', icon: 'server' },
  ],
  edges: [
    { id: 'e1', from: 'client', to: 'lb' },
    { id: 'e2', from: 'lb', to: 's1', label: '1st, 4th' },
    { id: 'e3', from: 'lb', to: 's2', label: '2nd, 5th' },
    { id: 'e4', from: 'lb', to: 's3', label: '3rd, 6th' },
  ],
});

const options: RenderDiagramOptions = { layout: { direction: 'right' } };
```

## Push

The sender delivers as soon as something happens. Receivers don't ask. Good when updates are rare and should arrive fast.

<picture>
  <source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="patterns/push.dark.svg">
  <img alt="Push delivery. A publisher sends each event to its subscribers as it happens." src="patterns/push.light.svg">
</picture>

```ts
import { defineDiagram } from 'diagrammar';
import type { RenderDiagramOptions } from 'diagrammar/server';

const diagram = defineDiagram({
  title: 'Push delivery',
  description: 'A publisher sends each event to its subscribers as it happens.',
  nodes: [
    { id: 'pub', label: 'Order service', icon: 'server' },
    { id: 'a', label: 'Email', icon: 'mail' },
    { id: 'b', label: 'Mobile app', icon: 'user' },
    { id: 'c', label: 'Webhook', icon: 'code' },
  ],
  edges: [
    { id: 'e1', from: 'pub', to: 'a', label: 'event' },
    { id: 'e2', from: 'pub', to: 'b', label: 'event' },
    { id: 'e3', from: 'pub', to: 'c', label: 'event' },
  ],
});

const options: RenderDiagramOptions = { layout: { direction: 'right' } };
```

## Pull

The receiver asks on its own schedule. It sets the pace, so a slow receiver never gets flooded, at the cost of some delay.

<picture>
  <source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="patterns/pull.dark.svg">
  <img alt="Pull delivery. A worker polls a queue and gets a job or nothing." src="patterns/pull.light.svg">
</picture>

```ts
import { defineDiagram } from 'diagrammar';
import type { RenderDiagramOptions } from 'diagrammar/server';

const diagram = defineDiagram({
  title: 'Pull delivery',
  description: 'A worker polls a queue and gets a job or nothing.',
  nodes: [
    { id: 'worker', label: 'Worker', icon: 'server' },
    { id: 'queue', label: 'Job queue', type: 'pill', role: 'warning' },
  ],
  edges: [
    { id: 'e1', from: 'worker', to: 'queue', label: 'any work?' },
    { id: 'e2', from: 'queue', to: 'worker', label: 'a job, or nothing', style: 'dashed' },
  ],
});

const options: RenderDiagramOptions = { layout: { direction: 'right' } };
```

## Publish and subscribe

Publishers don't know who listens. Each subscriber gets its own copy of every message on the topic.

<picture>
  <source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="patterns/pub-sub.dark.svg">
  <img alt="Publish and subscribe. One publisher, one topic, three independent subscribers." src="patterns/pub-sub.light.svg">
</picture>

```ts
import { defineDiagram } from 'diagrammar';
import type { RenderDiagramOptions } from 'diagrammar/server';

const diagram = defineDiagram({
  title: 'Publish and subscribe',
  description: 'One publisher, one topic, three independent subscribers.',
  nodes: [
    { id: 'pub', label: 'Checkout', icon: 'server' },
    { id: 'topic', label: 'orders topic', type: 'pill', role: 'primary' },
    { id: 'billing', label: 'Billing' },
    { id: 'ship', label: 'Shipping' },
    { id: 'stats', label: 'Analytics', role: 'muted' },
  ],
  edges: [
    { id: 'e1', from: 'pub', to: 'topic', label: 'publish' },
    { id: 'e2', from: 'topic', to: 'billing' },
    { id: 'e3', from: 'topic', to: 'ship' },
    { id: 'e4', from: 'topic', to: 'stats' },
  ],
});

const options: RenderDiagramOptions = { layout: { direction: 'right' } };
```

## Fan-out and fan-in

Split one job into pieces that run in parallel, then gather the results. Total time is the slowest piece, not the sum.

<picture>
  <source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="patterns/fan-out-fan-in.dark.svg">
  <img alt="Fan-out and fan-in. A splitter hands work to three workers and an aggregator combines the results." src="patterns/fan-out-fan-in.light.svg">
</picture>

```ts
import { defineDiagram } from 'diagrammar';
import type { RenderDiagramOptions } from 'diagrammar/server';

const diagram = defineDiagram({
  title: 'Fan-out and fan-in',
  description: 'A splitter hands work to three workers and an aggregator combines the results.',
  nodes: [
    { id: 'split', label: 'Splitter', role: 'primary' },
    { id: 'w1', label: 'Worker 1' },
    { id: 'w2', label: 'Worker 2' },
    { id: 'w3', label: 'Worker 3' },
    { id: 'agg', label: 'Aggregator', role: 'success' },
  ],
  edges: [
    { id: 'e1', from: 'split', to: 'w1' },
    { id: 'e2', from: 'split', to: 'w2' },
    { id: 'e3', from: 'split', to: 'w3' },
    { id: 'e4', from: 'w1', to: 'agg' },
    { id: 'e5', from: 'w2', to: 'agg' },
    { id: 'e6', from: 'w3', to: 'agg' },
  ],
});

const options: RenderDiagramOptions = { layout: { direction: 'right' } };
```

## Request and reply

The caller waits for an answer. Dashed lines show the replies.

<picture>
  <source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="patterns/request-reply.dark.svg">
  <img alt="Request and reply. A client sends a request to a service, which asks the database and replies." src="patterns/request-reply.light.svg">
</picture>

```ts
import { defineDiagram } from 'diagrammar';
import type { RenderDiagramOptions } from 'diagrammar/server';

const diagram = defineDiagram({
  title: 'Request and reply',
  description: 'A client sends a request to a service, which asks the database and replies.',
  nodes: [
    { id: 'client', label: 'Client', type: 'actor' },
    { id: 'svc', label: 'Service', icon: 'server' },
    { id: 'db', label: 'Database', type: 'database' },
  ],
  edges: [
    { id: 'e1', from: 'client', to: 'svc', label: 'request' },
    { id: 'e2', from: 'svc', to: 'client', label: 'response', style: 'dashed' },
    { id: 'e3', from: 'svc', to: 'db', label: 'query' },
    { id: 'e4', from: 'db', to: 'svc', label: 'rows', style: 'dashed' },
  ],
});

const options: RenderDiagramOptions = { layout: { direction: 'right' } };
```

## Circuit breaker

After repeated failures the breaker opens and stops calling the failing service. Callers get a fallback instead of waiting on timeouts.

<picture>
  <source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="patterns/circuit-breaker.dark.svg">
  <img alt="Circuit breaker. Calls pass through a breaker. When it is open they go to a fallback." src="patterns/circuit-breaker.light.svg">
</picture>

```ts
import { defineDiagram } from 'diagrammar';
import type { RenderDiagramOptions } from 'diagrammar/server';

const diagram = defineDiagram({
  title: 'Circuit breaker',
  description: 'Calls pass through a breaker. When it is open they go to a fallback.',
  nodes: [
    { id: 'client', label: 'Caller', type: 'actor' },
    { id: 'cb', label: 'Circuit breaker', role: 'warning' },
    { id: 'svc', label: 'Payments API', role: 'danger' },
    { id: 'fb', label: 'Cached answer', role: 'muted' },
  ],
  edges: [
    { id: 'e1', from: 'client', to: 'cb' },
    { id: 'e2', from: 'cb', to: 'svc', label: 'closed: call through' },
    { id: 'e3', from: 'cb', to: 'fb', label: 'open: fall back', style: 'dashed' },
  ],
});

const options: RenderDiagramOptions = { layout: { direction: 'right' } };
```

## CQRS

Writes and reads use different models. Commands change the write store, and events bring the read store up to date.

<picture>
  <source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="patterns/cqrs.dark.svg">
  <img alt="CQRS. Commands write to one database, and queries read from a separate, denormalized one." src="patterns/cqrs.light.svg">
</picture>

```ts
import { defineDiagram } from 'diagrammar';
import type { RenderDiagramOptions } from 'diagrammar/server';

const diagram = defineDiagram({
  title: 'CQRS',
  description: 'Commands write to one database, and queries read from a separate, denormalized one.',
  nodes: [
    { id: 'client', label: 'Client', type: 'actor' },
    { id: 'cmd', label: 'Command API', icon: 'code' },
    { id: 'w', label: 'Write store', type: 'database' },
    { id: 'q', label: 'Query API', icon: 'code' },
    { id: 'r', label: 'Read store', type: 'database', role: 'success' },
  ],
  edges: [
    { id: 'e1', from: 'client', to: 'cmd', label: 'commands' },
    { id: 'e2', from: 'cmd', to: 'w' },
    { id: 'e3', from: 'w', to: 'r', label: 'events', style: 'dashed' },
    { id: 'e4', from: 'client', to: 'q', label: 'queries' },
    { id: 'e5', from: 'q', to: 'r' },
  ],
});

const options: RenderDiagramOptions = { layout: { direction: 'right' } };
```

## Static site behind a CDN

Build once, upload to storage, and let the CDN serve it from the edge.

<picture>
  <source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="patterns/static-site.dark.svg">
  <img alt="Static site behind a CDN. A build pipeline uploads to storage. Visitors are served by the CDN, which fetches from storage on a miss." src="patterns/static-site.light.svg">
</picture>

```ts
import { defineDiagram } from 'diagrammar';
import type { RenderDiagramOptions } from 'diagrammar/server';

const diagram = defineDiagram({
  title: 'Static site behind a CDN',
  description: 'A build pipeline uploads to storage. Visitors are served by the CDN, which fetches from storage on a miss.',
  nodes: [
    { id: 'ci', label: 'Build pipeline', icon: 'code' },
    { id: 'store', label: 'Storage bucket', icon: 'box' },
    { id: 'cdn', label: 'CDN', icon: 'globe', role: 'primary' },
    { id: 'user', label: 'Visitors', type: 'actor' },
  ],
  edges: [
    { id: 'e1', from: 'ci', to: 'store', label: 'upload' },
    { id: 'e2', from: 'cdn', to: 'store', label: 'on a miss', style: 'dashed' },
    { id: 'e3', from: 'user', to: 'cdn' },
  ],
});

const options: RenderDiagramOptions = { layout: { direction: 'right' } };
```

## Saga with compensation

A long process split into local steps. If one fails, earlier steps are undone by compensating actions.

<picture>
  <source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="patterns/saga.dark.svg">
  <img alt="Saga with compensation. Order, payment, and stock steps, with a refund and cancellation when a step fails." src="patterns/saga.light.svg">
</picture>

```ts
import { defineDiagram } from 'diagrammar';
import type { RenderDiagramOptions } from 'diagrammar/server';

const diagram = defineDiagram({
  title: 'Saga with compensation',
  description: 'Order, payment, and stock steps, with a refund and cancellation when a step fails.',
  nodes: [
    { id: 'order', label: 'Create order' },
    { id: 'pay', label: 'Charge card' },
    { id: 'ship', label: 'Reserve stock' },
    { id: 'done', label: 'Confirmed', role: 'success' },
    { id: 'refund', label: 'Refund', role: 'danger' },
    { id: 'cancel', label: 'Cancel order', role: 'danger' },
  ],
  edges: [
    { id: 'e1', from: 'order', to: 'pay' },
    { id: 'e2', from: 'pay', to: 'ship' },
    { id: 'e3', from: 'ship', to: 'done' },
    { id: 'e4', from: 'ship', to: 'refund', label: 'out of stock', style: 'dashed' },
    { id: 'e5', from: 'refund', to: 'cancel', style: 'dashed' },
  ],
});

const options: RenderDiagramOptions = { layout: { direction: 'right' } };
```
